mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents ( user_id, type, title, content_json, plain_text, char_count, char_count_without_spaces, word_count, sentence_count ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, CAST(#{contentJson} AS JSONB), #{plainText}, #{charCount}, #{charCountWithoutSpaces}, #{wordCount}, #{sentenceCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, folder_id AS folderId, type, title, content_json::text AS contentJson, plain_text AS plainText, char_count AS charCount, char_count_without_spaces AS charCountWithoutSpaces, word_count AS wordCount, sentence_count AS sentenceCount, status, revision, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM documents WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, folder_id AS folderId, type, title, content_json::text AS contentJson, plain_text AS plainText, char_count AS charCount, char_count_without_spaces AS charCountWithoutSpaces, word_count AS wordCount, sentence_count AS sentenceCount, status, revision, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM documents WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, folder_id AS folderId, type, title, content_json::text AS contentJson, plain_text AS plainText, char_count AS charCount, char_count_without_spaces AS charCountWithoutSpaces, word_count AS wordCount, sentence_count AS sentenceCount, status, revision, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM documents WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE documents SET title = #{title}, content_json = CAST(#{contentJson} AS JSONB), plain_text = #{plainText}, char_count = #{charCount}, char_count_without_spaces = #{charCountWithoutSpaces}, word_count = #{wordCount}, sentence_count = #{sentenceCount}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND revision = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_versions ( document_id, version_no, save_request_id, title, content_json, plain_text, char_count, version_type ) VALUES ( #{documentId}, #{versionNo}, #{saveRequestId}, #{title}, CAST(#{contentJson} AS JSONB), #{plainText}, #{charCount}, #{versionType} )
mapper.update: UPDATE documents SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, purge_after = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '30 days', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
